name: Read a digital pin
description: Read a button, switch, or motion sensor connected to a GPIO pin.
setup_guide: This template returns `value` (0 or 1) and `is_high` (true/false) on every run. To see it on the dashboard: open the module, go to the Variables section, add a new variable named `value` (Type: number), then open that variable's Visualizations and add one with JSON Path `value`, Display Name 'Pin State', and Visualization Type 'number_display' or 'progress_bar' (min 0, max 1).
